description: Converts one document (PDF with a text layer, DOCX, PPTX, XLSX, XLS, HTML, CSV, JSON, XML, EPUB, TXT; sent as base64) to Markdown with Microsoft MarkItDown, keeping headings, lists and tables. Use it to feed a document's content to a model or search index as clean Markdown. Use job_ocr_tesseract instead for scanned PDFs or images without a text layer (they come back empty here, not charged). Use job_site_render instead for a live web page that needs JavaScript. Cost: at most $0.00006268 per call (measured CPU time), debited from your balance; an empty result or failed run is free. Auth: Authorization: Bearer <API key> (POST https://api.gaents.com/v1/accounts, $0.10 free credit); with no key the call returns a signed 402 quote payable in BSV or USDC via x402. Errors (isError, error.code): 400 missing_param/bad_param, 401 bad_api_key, 402 low balance, 429 busy (retry in seconds), 503 job_unavailable, 502 job_failed (refunded).

file_b64.description: The document file's bytes, base64-encoded, no data: prefix. (at most 3000000 bytes decoded)

filename.description: The document's file name; its extension (pdf, docx, pptx, xlsx, xls, html, htm, csv, json, xml, epub, txt, md) picks the converter.

name: job_doc_to_markdown
